lee: morning all — i'm Lee, starting on infra team. quick map please: who owns vault secrets, Dedicated onboarding, billing invites, and sec review? also what's the fastest route if a deploy is blocked by missing perms?

devex: welcome lee :wave: quick cheat-sheet below — copy into your notes. handbook has full flow: https://handbook.redwood.ai/start/first-week

nisha: security reviews + compliance = security@redwood.ai. for pre-ship reviews ping me or open PR with `SECURITY: review` in title. we usually reply within 1 business day.

ops: secrets + Vault access handled by infra-secrets (alias). request Vault read with this CLI: `vault token create -policy=dev-starter -ttl=8h -meta user=lee` (ops will rotate if needed). put the ticket id in the request thread.

devex: Dedicated onboarding and rollout handoff -> eng-platform channel. starter doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/platform/dedicated-starter. if you want a pairing session, reply with 2 preferred times.

ops: billing / cost center invites = finance-ops@redwood.ai. include your manager and project tag. they add you to the billing org and send cost-center instructions.

lee: nice. escalation pattern? what if i'm blocked late on Friday and need access to prod for a hotfix?

devex: escalation pattern we follow: 1) try owner (channel or person) 2) if no reply within 30m during business hours, ping `@oncall-eng` in the channel 3) after-hours or P0, trigger PagerDuty with `!pager` and page oncall. include incident tag and short impact statement.

oncall-bot: Eng oncall rota: today = Riley; next = Marcus. PagerDuty: https://pd.redwood.ai/org/eng (use `!pager` to page)

nisha: extra tip — for security-sensitive exceptions, add me on the page and include the minimal risk mitigation (temporary grant, audit log enabled). we permit short-lived access for emergency fixes but need postmortem.

lee: got it. i'll file the Vault request and DM for a pairing on Dedicated. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

devex: great — added this thread to starter-maps collection. shout if anything else pops up :sparkles:
